Accommodation

Guest information

Everything you need to know before you arrive.

Arrival and departure

Check-in from 15:00; earlier arrival is usually not possible because of cleaning. Check-out by 10:00; late check-out up to 13:00 is possible by arrangement for a fee set out in the terms.

Rules

  • Quiet hours: keep noise down after 22:00, complete silence from midnight – music and all other noise off
  • Cleaning: when renting the whole property, standard cleaning is added to the booking; for apartments in summer it is included. Exceptional mess is charged according to the terms
  • Please tell us about pets when booking. Dogs are free when renting the whole property. For summer apartment stays the dog fee is CZK 250 per night. The complex is fully fenced so your dog can't run off (we can't vouch for cats)
  • Free parking for 10 cars: 6 in the car park right opposite the complex (just across the road), 2 below the terrace along the road and 2 in front of apartment no. 1. The spaces below the terrace and in front of apartment no. 1 have an EV wallbox; charging is billed with the electricity used
  • Camping and caravan parking are not allowed around the complex
  • You can use the large fire pit with seating as much as you like; firewood is free for guests. Sausage sticks and a stainless-steel grill grate are by the fire pit
  • A ramp, also suitable for pushchairs, leads into the complex, to the pool and onto the terrace. Apartment no. 1 has access via a ramp without steps; the other apartments are up steps
  • Darts and table football in the shared areas are free for guests
  • On a regular stay you can borrow one of 4 rowing boats with oars for free; when renting the whole property, all 4. The water is a short walk away, at the Chmelnice landing
  • The terrace vending machine has drinks, sweets and things people often forget on holiday (phone charger, plasters, hand cream…)
  • The outdoor areas are monitored by cameras for safety. We only review recordings if a problem occurs.
  • Pool and hot tub: the equipment (filtration, water treatment and heating) must run continuously. Please do not switch it off, or the water will spoil.
  • Pool: The pool is not fenced. It has a sliding cover, which we recommend keeping closed whenever nobody is swimming so that no small child or animal can fall in. When the cover is open, an adult must supervise the pool at all times.
  • Winter: in winter the access road can be difficult. Please call us the day before arrival; we'll tell you the current conditions and the best way to reach us.
  • Firewood for the common-room fireplace is on the woodpile next to the fire pit and is included in the price.
  • When renting the whole property, operate the side curtains, hot tub and saunas as instructed by the host

Fishing

To fish on the Vranov reservoir you need a valid fishing licence and a paid permit from the anglers' association. Where to buy them is listed on vranovnaddyji.cz.

What you'll find in the apartment

  • Towel per person and bed linen. Linen for extra beds is in the wardrobe
  • Crockery, microwave, hob, kettle, fridge
  • TV, hairdryer, Wi-Fi (password in the room)
  • Toilet paper, soap, shower gel and shampoo
  • First-aid kit and fire extinguisher
  • Iron, ironing board and clothes airer
  • Cot on request (add it in the booking)

We recommend bringing

Swimwear and a bathrobe for the wellness area, blankets for evenings outside, slippers, insect repellent, matches and games.
